alerts.description: Alert records (package types.d.ts Alert): id, tagId, source, text, note, acknowledged, active, type, time (epoch milliseconds), shelved.

selectable.description: Whether each row starts with a tick box (the package checkbox) that selects it. A click on the tick toggles only the selection; a click elsewhere on the row is the row click as before.

selectedIds.description: The ids of the selected rows. Written by the component when a tick is toggled (bind it two ways); ticks show the ids in it, and an id of an alert the list no longer shows is dropped.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
